svg.title: TCP Fast Open
svg.desc: TCP Fast Open eliminates the standard three-way handshake delay by allowing data exchange during the initial SYN packet transmission. Using a cryptographic cookie verified during the first connection, subsequent handshakes securely transport payload data instantly, reducing round-trip time latency for web requests.

Enable TCP Fast Open on high-traffic origin servers and CDNs to
reduce connection latency for returning clients.
